name: custom138k-workstation-v1
purpose: Explicit native dual-rate and media-preparation runtime source checkpoint; not a release or hardware acceptance

features.name: usb_midi
features.selected_behavior: A2 HS/FS transport, production firmware and native input owner selected; Push/25K alternate on one port
features.remaining: I01: integrated enumeration, hotplug, session/PANIC and real audio acceptance

features.name: synthesis_ABC_vector
features.selected_behavior: Native dual-rate render/session/parameter composition; 18-bit events, lifecycle and global PANIC retained; one committed parameter owner
features.remaining: A01/A05: full integrated resource/timing and real performance

features.name: effects
features.selected_behavior: Native rate-aware Delay, Chorus and spatial Reverb; compute remains 76.8 MHz and selected MCLK only paces physical output
features.remaining: A02/A07: integrated routed timing, both-rate listening and hardware acceptance

features.name: audio_48k_i2s
features.selected_behavior: 12.288 MHz reference, I2S 32-bit slots, one final PCM/router and master gain before physical serial output and observation fanout
features.remaining: A03/A04: integrated physical stereo output, reset/CDC/clock budgets and routed timing

features.name: audio_44k1_switch
features.selected_behavior: Qualified 16.9344 MHz/12.288 MHz references and native DCS selection, quiesce/flush/epoch/prefill/failure policy; reserved zero epoch and initial epoch one; AE350 first entry preserves held notes and seals REC/BLE, cancels score and stops TF before the sole core request; backend terminal results and final TF ACK are required
features.remaining: A06/A07/I01: integrated endpoint/PLL/routed timing, source-loss and switching hardware acceptance

features.name: hdmi_ddr
features.selected_behavior: Shared scanout with native scan-window admission; runtime physical-frame observations publish all four metadata minor1 blocks with actual rate/epoch, cancellation and immutable cache ownership; raster consumes shared FFT/XY/meter caches, local duplicate FFT disabled
features.remaining: D01/D03/D04/F04: bounded all-client service, integrated reset/CDC audit, physical deadlines and hardware contention

features.name: fpga_visuals
features.selected_behavior: Native waveform, Lissajous, FFT and effect metadata from tagged final physical PCM observations; independent producer/export and local-cache raster leases
features.remaining: D02/D03: integrated resource/timing, remaining plots and hardware per-output acceptance

features.name: usb_display
features.selected_behavior: Existing Push pixels and 25K Host tile rendering retained
features.remaining: D05/D06: committed DDR pixel consumption and slow-end isolation

features.name: ae350
features.selected_behavior: AE350 UI/services C, headers, startup and linker script rebuilt into candidate boot.mem with tool, ELF, ROM and capacity evidence; bounded checked-MMIO clock submit/poll API linked, no automatic command or UI page added
features.remaining: C01-C05: bounded business services, whole-call-chain stack and hardware acceptance

features.name: ble_short_recording
features.selected_behavior: Existing business transport observes the runtime final physical PCM; legacy PCM16 capture remains 48 kHz only and rejects/counts incompatible observations; 16384-frame RAM capacity; native local seal preserves object ID/committed frames/CRC and leaves the wire contract unchanged
features.remaining: B01/R01: nonzero real audio, Android, rate-policy and AE350 business hardware acceptance

features.name: long_recording_ddr
features.selected_behavior: Runtime recording keeps the existing short on-chip path; an unselected 64 KiB dual-rate PCM DDR backend reserves 0x30500000..0x305fffff but has no production client or PCM CDC
features.remaining: R00/R02-R04: owner8/native commit routing, final PCM CDC, immutable business objects, reliable download, device testing and same-configuration physical resource comparison

features.name: tf_playback
features.selected_behavior: Maintained WAV/DDR transport through native tagged TF service into one final router; explicit user restart and cancellation, matching-rate admission, no automatic clock request or resampling; accepted reads drain before restart
features.remaining: M03/A03: integrated service/DDR timing, real-card playback/pause/source-loss and EOF/drain completion policy

features.name: recognition_guidance
features.selected_behavior: Explicit live CNN resource candidate and existing Push guidance; no accepted CNN promotion
features.remaining: M01/M02: model cold boot, recognition and concurrent playback acceptance

features.name: D_sampler
features.selected_behavior: Independent sampler source is retained, not selected as a complete-workstation source

features.name: lcd_touch
features.selected_behavior: LCD consumes shared snapshot; no touch input selected
features.remaining: D07: final product scope and hardware acceptance

features.name: wifi
features.selected_behavior: Wi-Fi is held disabled in this composition
features.remaining: B03: product scope and vertical integration

A2.scope: Push HS enumeration, unplug/replug recovery and MIDI reception on headless 138K probe

D5.scope: User-accepted standalone 1080p display and DDR path; no AE350 in this configuration

C1.scope: BLE business GATT, reconnect, short recording and CRC download; historical captured PCM was all zero
